_readme: Chengdu Trip Guide — reference links. The guide reads this file from data/reference.json and falls back to the copy baked into the HTML when it can't be reached. Add an entry by copying one of the objects below. 'url' can be an external link (https://...) or a file in the same data/ folder (data/whatever.html). 'kind' only changes the icon: pdf | page | sheet | map | link | image. Titles and descriptions take a plain string or {"en": ..., "zh": ...}.
